## Painted Porch Strategies (PPS): operating context

This project is the Painted Porch Strategies website. It is Painted Porch Strategies' own space, with its own website, code, database and client
delivery. Other businesses in the portfolio have their own projects: never bring their branding,
voice or data in here.

### Client records

All client relationship data goes to the one shared CRM (GoHighLevel today). This project's own
database may hold a reference to the CRM contact, never a rival copy of the relationship. When this
project sends a contact or deal to the CRM:

- Upsert the contact by email. Never create a duplicate contact.
- Add "Painted Porch Strategies" to the contact's Brands field. Append, never overwrite.
- Set First Touch Brand only when the contact is new.
- Record the source (which page or form) and any consent exactly as the person gave it.
- If you create an opportunity, set its Brand field to one brand ("Painted Porch Strategies") and choose pipeline and stage by ID, never by name.
- Never use tags as the brand record.
- Keep CRM keys server-side (edge or server functions only), never in browser code.

### Business decisions

Pricing, offers, tools, roles, and anything that touches another business are decided outside this
project, in the portfolio's internal operations hub. If a request would change one of those, flag it
instead of deciding it in code.

# Project rules

- LinkedIn article reading lives only in `supabase/functions/_shared/linkedin-article.ts`; the scanner imports through `import-linkedin-article` instead of parsing pages itself. Why: two copies of the cleanup rules drifted apart and broke imports.
- `youtube_videos` and `media_appearances` use `review_status` (pending/published); RLS hides pending from the public and public queries also filter on it. Why: scanned imports must wait for admin approval.
